releaseNotes: Live TV and the TV Guide use the same colors as the rest of the app. Coming back from a channel puts you on the channel you were watching, in the category you were in. The TV Guide is redesigned in the TiviMate style: a preview and program details at the top, channels down the left, a time line across; Left / Right move between programs, Up / Down between channels, OK plays, hold OK previews a live channel or sets a reminder, Left on the first program opens the groups. Movies and shows you have watched on Simkl or Trakt show a check mark (and their episodes in the episode list). The player has an Audio and subtitles picker (another audio track, other subtitles, or off), Left / Right skip during playback, and Down steps into the control bar (Left / Right move along it, OK presses a button, Up goes back to the picture); the bar stays up while you use it. Watched episodes (and movies) show a check mark, and sources are listed IPTV first, then best quality first, then most seeders. Movies and shows now list debrid sources (torrents and release-site hosters) once a debrid service is paired, and picking one plays it through your service. Pairing a premium service or tracker (Simkl, Trakt, WeTrakr, MDBList) shows a QR code next to the address and code, a service that does not answer the first time is retried, and finishing a pairing no longer shows a load error. Movies and TV Shows have a Favorites row, hold OK on a poster to add or remove a favorite, and Radio shows your Continue Watching and Favorites. HazMat TV is now built the Starfleet way: Home with widgets (highlight Movies, TV Shows, Live TV, Anime, Sports, Radio or Settings to see its widgets), autoplay trailers in English, Continue Watching, Favorites (on your profile or a TMDB list), cast with photos (open an actor to see everything they have been in), release and air dates, certification and the content advisory. Pair premium services and your trackers (Simkl, Trakt, WeTrakr, MDBList) in Settings; IPTV movies and shows are a source on every title and listed under IPTV Movies / IPTV TV Shows. Profiles, My Teams alerts (including the FloHockey leagues), split screen (side by side or top and bottom, mixing IPTV, movies and live sports), and Left / Right now skip back and forward during playback. Your IPTV providers, debrid pairings and trackers carry over from the old version. Needs Android 7 or newer.
